name: ComputeEval
intro: ComputeEval是NVIDIA持续维护的CUDA代码生成基准。2026.1版本包含566道题，覆盖7个CUDA C++与CUDA Python领域组，其中499题带性能负载。模型仅看到提示、上下文和构建约束；隐藏测试与参考解用于隔离的编译、正确性验证，并在通过后可继续测量GPU性能。
build_method: NVIDIA工程师与模型辅助编题, 全量人工复核, 隐藏测试与参考解隔离, CI可解性验证, 版本化数据包
metric: Pass@k, Latency, Baseline Speedup, SM/DRAM Throughput
eval_feature: 隐藏测试, 隔离执行, 分领域报告, GPU性能剖析
build_method_en: NVIDIA Engineer and Model-assisted Authoring, Full Human Review, Hidden-test and Reference Separation, CI Solvability Validation, Versioned Datapacks
eval_feature_en: Held-out Tests, Isolated Execution, Per-group Reporting, GPU Performance Profiling
intro_en: ComputeEval is NVIDIA's continuously maintained CUDA code-generation benchmark. Release 2026.1 contains 566 problems across seven CUDA C++ and CUDA Python groups, with performance workloads for 499 problems. Models see only prompts, context, and build constraints; held-out tests and reference solutions support isolated compilation and correctness checks, followed by optional GPU performance measurement for passing solutions.
metric_en: Pass@k, Latency, Baseline Speedup, SM/DRAM Throughput
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the NVIDIA ComputeEval technical blog, official repository README, DATASET_CARD.md, DOMAIN_MAP.md, and CHANGELOG.md. The previous arXiv:2602.12305 link is an OptiML method paper that only cites ComputeEval and does not define its construction; it has therefore been removed. The official 2026.1 contract contains 566 human-reviewed problems across seven groups, with hybrid engineer/model-assisted authoring, held-out tests and reference solutions, CI validation of known-good solutions, generation/evaluation visibility separation, isolated compile-and-test execution, and optional post-correctness performance profiling for 499 problems.
